thread:
samir: Quick copy drop for landing + social + webinar routing. Need 2 hero variants per mode (short) + one-sentence subhead, a single social-safe benchmark teaser, and final HubSpot routing snippet. Handoff by noon tomorrow.

hannah: Tone guide: Hosted = sultry PLG (fast, playful), Dedicated = matter-of-fact (SLOs, cost), Private = formal (security/compliance). Keep CTAs 1-3 words.

oliver: Draft heroes & subheads (A/B):
- Hosted A: "Start with Redwood Hosted" — "Prototype fast, ship faster." — CTA: "Try Hosted"
- Hosted B: "Hosted API for builders" — "Spin up models in minutes." — CTA: "Start free"
- Dedicated A: "Reserve dedicated capacity" — "Throughput you can depend on." — CTA: "Reserve"
- Dedicated B: "Dedicated GPUs, predictable latency" — "SLA-backed performance for production." — CTA: "Get capacity"
- Private A: "Private deployments" — "VPC, KMS, and on-prem options for compliance." — CTA: "Request demo"
- Private B: "Run Redwood in your network" — "Keep data in your control." — CTA: "Contact sales"

fran: Social benchmark teaser (single short line):
"Join our webinar for independent latency & cost comparisons across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments."

samir: Nice. Need one micro-variant for the webinar reg confirmation email and the registration page microcopy.

hannah: Reg page microcopy (short): "Register for a 60-min session: 30m demo, 15m benchmark walkthrough, 15m live Q&A. Select Hosted/Dedicated/Private interest to route to the right team."

oliver: Confirmation email microcopy (short): "Thanks for registering — calendar invite sent. Got Dedicated/Private interest? Reply to this email and we'll connect you to an AE. Watch the live benchmark walkthrough."

samir: HubSpot routing snippet (pseudo-code we can hand to ops):
```
# form field: deployment_interest -> values: hosted, dedicated, private
if form.deployment_interest == "hosted":
  set lifecycle_stage = "MQL"
  owner = "marketing"
  add_hidden utm_campaign = "launch_webinar"
elif form.deployment_interest == "dedicated":
  set owner = "AE_pool"
  tag = "dedicated_lead"
  notify = "ae-team@redwood.com"
elif form.deployment_interest == "private":
  set owner = "Enterprise_SDR"
  priority = "high"
  notify = "sales-enterprise@redwood.com"
```
Please convert to HubSpot workflow JSON and push IDs back here.

copybot: Tiny alt CTAs for experimentation: ["Try Hosted", "Start free", "Reserve", "Get capacity", "Request demo", "Contact sales"].

fran: OK folks 99Summary tasks: Oliver  add these variants into the launch doc and flag the primary hero per mode. Hannah  pick the social teaser and format for LinkedIn/X. Samir  follow up with ops for HubSpot workflow JSON and post IDs. I'll collect the confirmed copy and hand off to design. Thanks :rocket:
